scripts.build: bun run build:engine && bun run build:runtime && bun run build:test-preview && bun run build:sdk
scripts.generate:protocol: cargo run --quiet --manifest-path tools/schema-gen/Cargo.toml -- --write && bun run generate:packed-abi
scripts.verify:boundaries: bun run scripts/verify-boundaries.ts && bun run verify:protocol
scripts.gate: bun run fmt:check && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run build && bun test && bun run verify:boundaries
scripts.lint: cd .. && oxlint -c web/.oxlintrc.json --deny-warnings --report-unused-disable-directives web/apps web/packages web/scripts web/tests .github/scripts
scripts.lint:fix: cd .. && oxlint --fix -c web/.oxlintrc.json --deny-warnings --report-unused-disable-directives web/apps web/packages web/scripts web/tests .github/scripts
